# Flare UI

Flare UI is a cross-platform UI system for Vue, Flutter, Android Compose, and SwiftUI, including General UI, IM UI, and reusable workspace patterns.

## Boundary

`tokens/` and `spec/` are authoritative. The four packages are native implementations. Products own data, permissions, persistence, and side effects. Vue PC is a reference implementation, not the contract source.

## Start here

Complete [Getting started](/en/guide/getting-started), then open [General UI](/en/general/), [IM UI](/en/im/), [Patterns](/en/patterns/), or the [platform guides](/en/platforms/).

## Stability

The generated [Component Catalog](/en/components/) exposes status, support, version, docs, and example coverage; CI verifies it.
